title: 第十二章 清玄阁
content_zh:
张若尘穿着一身白衣，身体站得笔直，微微诧异的看了云儿一眼，轻轻点了点头，道： “成功了！已经突破到黄极境后期！云儿姐姐，你怎么还不去休息？”
云儿听到张若尘的话，整个人都懵掉了，心脏狂跳不已，心中说不出的激动，竟然有一种想要哭出来的感觉。
“真是太好了！真是太好了！”云儿一边抹着眼睛，一边说道： “云儿说过要帮九王子殿下看守大门，就肯定不会离开。”
张若尘心中生出几分感动，将一枚血丹取出来，递给云儿。
“下雪了，别冻着了，你早点去休息吧！将这枚血丹服下，应该能够暖和不少！”张若尘道。
云儿接过血丹，紧紧的捧在手中，深深的点了点头，一边向自己的住处走去，一边心中暗想着，今晚，恐怕将是一个不眠夜！
将云儿送回去之后，张若尘再次回到满是积雪的院落的中央。
站在雪中，静止不动，任凭雪花一片片落在头顶和肩上。
“静如卧象，动如狂龙。龙象般若掌第二掌，飞龙在天！”
忽然，张若尘猛然向地面踏了一步，无数雪花冲飞起来。他的双臂和双腿就像是化为一个疾速旋转的涡轮，卷起无数白雪。
借助腿部的蹬力，他的身体腾飞起七米多高，嘴里发出低亢的龙吟声，一掌击向十丈外的一块千斤大石。
“轰！”
那一块千斤大石立即四，残石向着四面八方飞去，坠落到厚厚的积雪中。
张若尘站在雪地中，盯着残破的大石，带着几分欣喜， “终于将龙象般若掌第二掌修炼成功。现在，龙象般若掌的威力，堪比人级中品的武技。”
不仅是第二掌 “飞龙在天”，第一掌 “蛮象驰地”也达到人级中品的武技的威力。
若是张若尘修炼成第三掌，那么龙象般若掌的威力就堪比人级上品的武技。
每多修炼成一掌，就会提升一个品级，变得更加高明和玄妙。
“龙象般若掌第一掌，蛮象驰地！”
张若尘脚踩步伐，狂冲出去，身体如同一头疾速奔跑的蛮象，一掌打在空气中，发出一连串的气爆声。
无数雪花，被掌力震飞出去，在空气中，融化成一滴滴冰水。

“第一掌‘蛮象驰地"虽然比第二掌的威力稍弱一分，可是的的确确达到人级中品武技的威力了。龙象般若掌，真是玄妙。”
以他现在的力量，不说达到一头蛮象的力量，至少是达到一头蛮牛的力量了！
在武修中，这被称为 “一牛之力”。
要知道，并不是每一个黄极境后期的武者都能爆发出 “一牛之力”。能够爆发出 “一牛之力”，在黄极境后期的武者中已经属于中上水平。
张若尘才刚刚修炼到黄极境后期而已，借助体内六条经脉的优势，加上龙象般若掌的威力，就已经可以爆发出 “一牛之力”，可谓是潜力无穷。
随着今后修为加深，肉身增强，他肯定能够爆发出更加强大的力量。
张若尘将院落中的残石全部清理掉之后，重新返回房间，没有再修炼，而是躺在床上，让自己完全放松，进入沉睡。
突破黄极境后期之后，终于可以安稳的睡一觉。
他本以为需要三个月时间，才能达到这个境界。可是借助时空灵晶的时间力量和大量修炼资源，仅仅只用了半个月，就达到这个境界。
在岁末考核之前，他有信心突破到更高境界。
休息一夜，张若尘的精气神再次变得十分饱满，浑身充满力量。
“聚气丹和炼体散已经消耗了大半，再去武
市购买一些。”
与林妃和云儿一起吃过早饭，张若尘便独自一人离开王宫，向着武市中行去。
来到丹市，走进一家叫做 “清玄阁”的店铺。
这家店铺开在十字路口，在丹市中属于排名前三的大铺，过往的武者大多都会进来看一看，有的来购买合适的丹药，有的则是来贩卖刚刚采集到的珍贵药材。
一位嘴角边长着一颗黑痣的老者，不知什么时候，走到张若尘的身后，笑眯眯的问道： “这位公子，你是要购买聚气丹？”
张若尘心头微微一惊，转身向那老者深深的看了一眼。
这个老者有些不简单，居然可以无声无息的走到张若尘的身后，若不是他主动开口说话，张若尘都难以发现他。
绝对是一位武道高手！

那一位老者笑了笑，自我介绍： “老朽，墨翰林，乃是这一家丹铺的掌柜。”
“原来是掌柜，在下姓张。”张若尘点了点头，又道： “我要购枚聚气丹，三十份炼体散。不知道清玄阁有没有足够多的存量？”
墨翰林的心头微微一惊，好大一笔单子，只有那些大家族才会一次性购买如此多的修炼资源。单个武者购买这么多丹药，太少见了。
聚气丹和炼体散都不是便宜的东西，寻常武者根本买不起。
“若是张少爷去别家，说不定真的买不到这么多丹药。真是巧了，我们清玄阁正好有一批聚气丹和炼体散，绝对能够满足张少爷的需求。”
墨翰林取出一个算盘，噼噼啪啪的拨弄一番，嘴角微微一笑，道：枚聚气丹，三十份炼体散，原价是八万枚银币。不过，张少爷一次性采购如此大的份量，自然有一定的优惠。嗯！你就付七万二千枚银币吧！”
张若尘笑道： “掌柜，你真是一个爽快人，今后购买丹药，我都在你这里买了。”
张若尘身上所剩的银币已经不多，不够支付如此大一笔巨款，于是便先去武市钱庄提取了二十万枚银币出来。
花费七万二千枚银币，加上之前剩的银币，他的身上总共还有十三枚银币。
完成这一笔大买卖，墨翰林的脸都要笑成花，道： “张少爷，不知道，你还购不购买别的东西？”
张若尘道： “我要购买的东西，掌柜你这里肯定没有卖。”
墨翰林道： “难道张少爷是要买一件趁手的兵器？”
张若尘对这位掌柜更加高看几分，道： “掌柜好厉害的眼力。”
墨翰林笑了笑道： “做了几十年的掌柜，见过的武者没有一万，也有八千，还从来没有见过几个人随身不佩戴兵器。这样吧！我们清玄阁在器市也有分店，我让一个小伙计，带你过去。”
片刻之后，墨翰林找来一个六岁的小胖子，对他说道： “憨子，立即带这位尊贵的张少爷去器市，告诉老板娘，张公子是我们清玄阁的贵客，在价格上要给张公子适当的优惠。”
叫做憨子的小胖子瞪大了一双眼睛，使劲的摇头，道： “不去！不去！我才不要见老板娘，老板娘能够勾走男人的魂。见到她，就死定了。”
墨翰林气急败坏，粗声道： “你又不是男人，你现在顶多只能算是一个半大的男孩子，有什么好怕？好吧！你若是不去，这个月就不发给你聚气丹了。”
憨子顿时急了，连忙道： “别，别，我去，我去！我去还不行！”
憨子向着张若尘走过来，恭恭敬敬的道： “张少爷，请吧！”
张若尘点了点头，跟着憨子，向着器市行去。

张若尘总觉得这位清玄阁的掌柜有些古怪，似乎不是一般人。当然，他并不担心对方心存歹意，毕竟武市中有军队看
守，管理十分严格，根本没有人敢在武市中乱来。
憨子低声的道： “张少爷，你真的要去老板娘那里买兵器？老板娘可是能够勾走男人的魂！张少爷，你是男人吗？”
“额……我也只是男孩子！”张若尘道。
憨子长长的松了一口气，道： “那就太好了！”
憨子长得白白胖胖，头上扎着一个冲天辫，长着两只招风耳，眼睛小得就像黄豆一样。
张若尘有些好奇，道： “你说老板娘能够勾走男人的魂，难道老板娘长得十分漂亮？”
憨子点了点头，道： “老板娘自然长得十分漂亮，简直国色天香，性/感妖/娆，一个眼神盯过来，就让人的小心脏扑通扑通的跳，看她一眼都会让人脸红心乱。但是，你不知道的是，老板娘已经嫁过了七位老板。”
“嫁过了七位老板？”张若尘有些诧异。
憨子又道： “对啊！七位老板都死了，全部死在洞房花烛夜。”
张若尘道： “七位老板死后，他们的产业呢？”
“自然都是老板娘的了！就连我们家掌柜，也只是给老板娘打工而已。”
憨子低声道： “老板娘简直就是天煞孤星，勾魂使者转世，狐狸成精，任何男人见了她都很难活过三天。幸好我们都是男孩子，应该不会被她勾走魂儿。”
张若尘点了点头，道： “希望吧！”
content_en:
Zhang Ruochen was wearing white clothes and stood up straight. He glanced at Yun'er in surprise, nodded slightly and said, "Successful! We have broken through to the late stage of Huang Ji Realm! Sister Yun'er, why don't you go rest?"
When Yun'er heard Zhang Ruochen's words, she was completely stunned. Her heart was beating wildly. She was so excited that she couldn't describe it, and she felt like she wanted to cry.
"It's so good! It's so good!" Yun'er said while wiping her eyes: "Yun'er said that he would help His Highness the Ninth Prince guard the gate, so he will definitely not leave."
Zhang Ruochen felt a little moved in his heart, took out a blood pill and handed it to Yun'er.
"It's snowing, don't freeze. Go and rest early! Taking this blood pill should make you feel much warmer!" Zhang Ruochen said.
Yun'er took the blood pill, held it tightly in her hands, nodded deeply, and walked towards her residence, thinking to herself that tonight, I'm afraid it will be a sleepless night!
After sending Yun'er back, Zhang Ruochen returned to the center of the snow-covered courtyard.
Stand still in the snow, letting the snowflakes fall on your head and shoulders.
"Silent like a lying elephant, moving like a wild dragon. With the second palm of the Dragon-Elephant Prajna Palm, the flying dragon is in the sky!"
Suddenly, Zhang Ruochen suddenly took a step towards the ground, and countless snowflakes flew up. His arms and legs seemed to turn into a rapidly rotating turbine, rolling up countless white snow.
With the help of his legs, his body flew up to a height of more than seven meters. He let out a low dragon roar from his mouth and struck a heavy stone ten feet away with one palm.
"Boom!"
The huge stone suddenly fell apart, and the remaining stones flew in all directions and fell into the thick snow.
Zhang Ruochen stood in the snow, staring at the broken boulder, with some joy, "Finally, I have successfully practiced the second palm of the Dragon Elephant Prajna Palm. Now, the power of the Dragon Elephant Prajna Palm is comparable to a mid-level human-level martial arts."
Not only the second palm "Flying Dragon in the Sky", but the first palm "Wild Elephant Riding on the Ground" also reached the power of a mid-level human-level martial arts.
If Zhang Ruochen masters the third palm, then the power of the Dragon Elephant Prajna Palm will be comparable to the top-grade human-level martial arts.
Every time you practice one more palm, it will be upgraded to a level and become more brilliant and mysterious.
"The first palm of the Dragon-Elephant Prajna Palm, the wild elephant gallops to the ground!"
Zhang Ruochen stepped on his feet and rushed out, his body like a running elephant, hitting the air with his palm, making a series of explosions.
Countless snowflakes were blown away by the force of the palm, melting into droplets of ice water in the air.
Although the power of the "first palm 'Barbarian Elephant Chi Di'" is slightly weaker than the second palm, it has indeed reached the power of a mid-level human-level martial arts. Dragon Elephant Prajna Palm is really mysterious. "
With his current strength, not only the strength of a wild elephant, but at least the strength of a wild bull!
In martial arts, this is called "the power of an ox".
You must know that not every warrior in the late Huangji realm can burst out with the "power of an ox". Being able to burst out "the power of an ox" is already above average among warriors in the late Huangji realm.
Zhang Ruochen has just reached the late stage of Huang Ji Realm. With the advantages of the six meridians in his body and the power of the Dragon Elephant Prajna Palm, he can already unleash the "power of an ox", which can be said to have unlimited potential.
As his cultivation deepens and his physical body strengthens in the future, he will definitely be able to explode with more powerful power.
After Zhang Ruochen cleared away all the remaining stones in the courtyard, he returned to the room. He did not practice anymore, but lay on the bed, allowing himself to completely relax and fall into a deep sleep.
After breaking through the late Huangji realm, I could finally sleep peacefully.
He originally thought it would take three months to reach this level. However, with the help of the time power of the space-time spiritual crystal and a large amount of cultivation resources, it only took half a month to reach this state.
Before the year-end assessment, he is confident of breaking through to a higher levelrealm.
After a night's rest, Zhang Ruochen's energy became very full again, and his whole body was full of strength.
“Most of the Qi Gathering Pill and Body Refining Powder have been consumed.
Market to buy some. "
After having breakfast with Concubine Lin and Yun'er, Zhang Ruochen left the palace alone and headed towards Wushi Zhongxing.
When I came to Dan City, I walked into a shop called "Qingxuan Pavilion".
This shop is located at a crossroads and is one of the top three shops in the Alchemy City. Most of the passing warriors will come in to take a look. Some come to buy suitable elixirs, while others come to sell the precious medicinal materials they have just collected.
An old man with a black mole on the corner of his mouth walked up behind Zhang Ruochen at some point and asked with a smile: "Sir, do you want to buy a Qi Gathering Pill?"
Zhang Ruochen was slightly startled, turned around and took a deep look at the old man.
This old man was a bit extraordinary. He could actually walk up behind Zhang Ruochen silently. If he hadn't taken the initiative to speak, it would have been difficult for Zhang Ruochen to spot him.
Definitely a martial arts master!
The old man smiled and introduced himself: "Old man, Mo Hanlin, is the shopkeeper of this alchemy shop."
"It turns out to be the shopkeeper, my surname is Zhang." Zhang Ruochen nodded and said, "I want to buy a Qi Gathering Pill and thirty copies of the Body Refining Powder. I wonder if Qingxuan Pavilion has enough in stock?"
Mo Hanlin was slightly shocked. It was such a big deal. Only those big families would purchase so many cultivation resources at once. It is very rare for a single warrior to purchase so many elixirs.
Qi Gathering Pills and Body Refining Powders are not cheap items, and ordinary warriors cannot afford them.
"If Master Zhang went to another place, he might not be able to buy so many pills. What a coincidence, our Qingxuan Pavilion happens to have a batch of Qi Gathering Pills and Body Refining Powders, which can definitely meet Master Zhang's needs."
Mo Hanlin took out an abacus, fiddled with it, smiled slightly, and said: One Qi Gathering Pill, thirty portions of Body Refining Powder, the original price is 80,000 silver coins. However, Master Zhang naturally has certain discounts for purchasing such a large amount at one time. Um! Just pay 72,000 silver coins! "
Zhang Ruochen smiled and said: "Shopkeeper, you are such a cheerful person, I will buy all the elixirs I buy from you in the future. "
Zhang Ruochen didn't have many silver coins left on him, which was not enough to pay such a huge sum of money, so he went to Wushi Bank to withdraw 200,000 silver coins.
After spending 72,000 silver coins, plus the remaining silver coins from before, he still had a total of thirteen silver coins on his body.
After completing this big deal, Mo Hanlin's face turned into a smile and he said: "Master Zhang, I don't know, do you want to buy anything else? "
Zhang Ruochen said: "The shopkeeper definitely doesn't sell the things I want to buy here. "
Mo Hanlin said: "Does Master Zhang want to buy a handy weapon? "
Zhang Ruochen thought more highly of the shopkeeper and said, "The shopkeeper has such great eyesight. "
Mo Hanlin smiled and said: "As a shopkeeper for decades, I have seen not only ten thousand but also eight thousand warriors, and I have never seen a few people without weapons. So be it! Our Qingxuan Pavilion also has a branch in the Qi Market. I'll ask a boy to take you there. "
After a while, Mo Hanlin found a six-year-old fat man and said to him: "Idiot, take this distinguished young master Zhang to the utensil market immediately and tell the lady boss that Mr. Zhang is a distinguished guest of our Qingxuan Pavilion, and we must give Mr. Zhang an appropriate discount on the price. "
The little fat man named Hanzi widened his eyes, shook his head vigorously, and said: "No! Don’t go! I don't want to see the boss's wife. The boss's wife can seduce a man's soul. If you see her, you will be dead. "
Mo Hanlin was furious and said in a rough voice: "You are not a man, you are only a half-grown boy now, what are you afraid of? All right! If you don’t go, this monthI won’t give you Qi Gathering Pills. "
The fool suddenly became anxious and said quickly: "No, no, I'm going, I'm going! It’s not okay for me to go! "
Hanzi walked towards Zhang Ruochen and said respectfully: "Master Zhang, please! "
Zhang Ruochen nodded and followed Hanzi towards the utensil market.
Zhang Ruochen always felt that the shopkeeper of Qingxuan Pavilion was a bit weird, and he seemed to be no ordinary person. Of course, he is not worried about the other party's malicious intentions. After all, there are troops watching in Wu City.
The management is very strict, and no one dares to mess around in Wu City.
The fool said in a low voice: "Master Zhang, are you really going to buy weapons from the landlady? The boss lady can steal a man's soul! Master Zhang, are you a man? "
“Well… I’m just a boy! "Zhang Ruochen said.
Hanzi breathed a long sigh of relief and said, "That's great! "
Hanzi is white and fat, with a braid on his head, two wind-catching ears, and eyes as small as soybeans.
Zhang Ruochen was a little curious and said: "You said that the boss's wife can steal a man's soul, is it possible that the boss's wife is very beautiful? "
The fool nodded and said: "The boss lady is naturally very beautiful. She is absolutely gorgeous and sexy. Just one look at her will make your heart skip a beat, and just one look at her will make you blush. But what you don’t know is that the boss lady has married seven bosses. "
“Married to seven bosses? "Zhang Ruochen was a little surprised.
The fool said again: "Yes! All seven bosses died, all on the wedding night. "
Zhang Ruochen said: "After the death of the seven bosses, what about their properties? "
"Of course they all belong to the boss lady! Even our shopkeeper only works for the proprietress. "
The fool whispered: "The boss's wife is simply a lone star of evil. She is reincarnated as a seductress and a fox becomes a spirit. It will be difficult for any man to survive for more than three days after seeing her. Fortunately, we are both boys and should not be distracted by her. "
Zhang Ruochen nodded and said, "I hope so! "
